summary: Phase 1 end-to-end testing complete. Backend pytest: 20/20 passed. Frontend Playwright: all 18 critical user flows passed (auth, role-gated nav, calculator acceptance values $5,623.20, pricing CRUD persistence, user create + deactivate, logout, mobile responsive at 375px).

issues: Radix a11y warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent. Add <DialogDescription/> or aria-describedby to satisfy a11y.

action_items: (Minor / a11y) Add DialogDescription to Create-User dialog (/app/frontend/src/pages/Users.jsx) to remove Radix warning.

(Optional hardening) Backend uses `CORS_ORIGINS=*` together with `allow_credentials=True`; if cookies/credentials are later added, switch to explicit allowed origins (currently safe because auth is Bearer-only).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 528-line file – acceptable for Phase 1 MVP but should be split (auth, users, settings, calculator) before Phase 2 to keep <700 lines/module.
All DB calls are async via motor — good. `_id` is stripped in every find_one/find call — no ObjectId leakage.
Pydantic validation, HTTP status codes (401/403/400/409/422/201) and Bearer auth dependencies are correctly implemented.
seed_database() is idempotent and updates password hash if changed via .env (matches playbook).
Calculator math is exact to the acceptance criteria (volume 2.70 m³, subtotal $5112, GST $511.20, total $5623.20).
PUT /api/settings/pricing followed by recalculation correctly reflects new prices (verified by +$10/m² bump increasing subtotal by $180 = 18 m² × $10).

Frontend correctly uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via /lib/api.js; token stored under `paneltec_token`; ProtectedRoute + admin gate on /users and /settings/pricing both server-enforced (403) and client-enforced (redirect to /).
data-testid coverage is excellent across all listed components — made automated testing very smooth.
seed_data_creation: Tests create one TEST_ user per run (test_user_<hex>@paneltec-test.com, qa_staff_<hex>@paneltec.com.au); user-mgmt test bumps wall_standard material by +$1 then reverts; calculator pricing-bump test bumps +$10 then reverts. Final pricing matches seed defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 20 tests, ~4s). Run: `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Email validator rejects `.test` TLD — use `.com` or `.com.au`. Sidebar uses Tailwind `xl:` (1280px) breakpoint; below that it slides off-screen and `[data-testid="mobile-menu-toggle"]` opens it. Logout button is inside Radix Dropdown portal — wait_for_selector(state='visible') after opening the user-menu-trigger.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found; the single failing test on first run was a test-author email TLD issue (`.test` reserved per RFC), fixed in the test file.
